standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies U -> X and W_i -> X_i surjective etale from schemes.

standard_prerequisites.name: Scheme-level etale dominance of smooth coverings
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: More on Morphisms, lemma etale-dominates-smooth (cross-chapter, named)
standard_prerequisites.use: Refines smooth coverings of schemes by etale coverings.

core_obligations: Choose a scheme U with surjective etale U -> X and schemes W_i with surjective etale W_i -> X_i; then {W_i -> X} is a smooth covering refining {X_i -> X}.
Form {W_i x_X U -> U} and observe it is a smooth covering of schemes.
Apply the scheme dominance lemma to get an etale covering {U_j -> U} refining it.
Compose with U -> X: {U_j -> X} is an etale covering of X refining {X_i -> X}.
proof_roadmap: Chart reduction to schemes, scheme-level dominance, compose back over X.
difficulty_reason: The chart trick plus fibre-product compatibility is a real reduction; the dominance statement for spaces is not a definition check.
